h1g: The system chases, assigns and escalates — so your team doesn't.
lede: Most businesses run on someone remembering: to chase the supplier, to tell the buyer, to move the plan when a date slips. This makes the process itself remember. Every stage has an owner, a due date and a chase ladder; when something slips, the right people hear about it in the right order — and a human is asked only when a real decision is needed.
semi: Built as the AI project manager inside a garment exporter's ERP, where it raised 112 suggestions and created every task for 200+ orders without a manager writing one. About 70% is ready — the engine, ladders, tasks, digests. 30% is your stages, your people, your rules.

ref_h: The AI is the project manager.
ref_hg: Not a chat box in the corner.
ref_p: In the garment exporter's ERP, the AI sits at the centre of the workflow: it builds the plan for every order, creates the tasks for the right person at the right stage, reads the inputs from email and portals so the system updates itself, and flags the handful of things that need a human decision each morning. The old process depended on people remembering; the new one asks for a human only when a decision is genuinely needed.

faq: The chases go to suppliers and buyers first; internally it creates tasks and asks questions, it doesn't grade people. Teams tend to like it because it takes the remembering off them.
What if it chases the wrong person?
Every action starts in "ask first" mode and is promoted one at a time once you've seen it behave. Ownership rules are yours to edit.
No. It reads from what you have — sheets, email, WhatsApp, Tally — and writes tasks and digests. An ERP makes it stronger, not necessary.
How does it know a supplier is late?
From evidence: no goods-receipt against a due date, no reply to a message, a portal status unchanged — not from someone remembering to tick a box.
Yes — escalation can place a call through our AI calling product, with the transcript logged against the order.
You. Every message, task and decision the system took is logged with the evidence it acted on.
